mike_devex: Heads-up: publishing flow failed — typegen produced duplicated changelog entries for v1.12.0 -> v1.12.1, CI blocked.

sarah_engineering: ugh, saw that. Is it the changelog generator or semver tag parsing?

raj_typegen: root cause looks like two PRs changed the OpenAPI property ordering; our changelog dedupe relies on commit-derived sections but the publish script splits by '###' and ends up duplicating when templates reorder.

mike_devex: can you share repro steps?

raj_typegen: repro: checkout main @ v1.12.0, merge the two PRs locally, then run: `./scripts/generate-changelog.sh --since v1.12.0` — output shows the same human-facing entry twice with different metadata. Logs snippet:
```
> git log --pretty=%B ...
> Generated changelog: - Fix auth retry for SDK init
> Generated changelog: - Fix auth retry for SDK init
```

taylor_sdk: we hit a similar thing earlier when sampleapp's enum ordering changed — typegen produced different type hashes which triggered regendiff noise. It blocked our sdk ci publish.

mike_devex: CI error is `typegen-regen check failed` — publishing blocked. Can we hotfix the dedupe logic to be more robust? @raj_typegen

raj_typegen: proposing: normalize changelog entries by trimming, collapsing whitespace, and normalizing punctuation, then sort the normalized entries before dedupe check. Keep final file in original order except for removed duplicates. I'll open a small patch and unit tests.

sarah_engineering: will that preserve author order/citation? release notes sometimes depend on PR order for context.

raj_typegen: good point — plan: only sort for the duplicate-detection set; when duplicates are found we remove extras but keep the earliest-appearing instance in the file. That preserves chronology.

mike_devex: sounds reasonable. Assign to @raj_typegen. Please add an integration test that simulates different OpenAPI property orders producing identical human entries. Also add a short doc blurb explaining the nondeterministic ordering root cause.

ci-bot: build started for branch fix/changelog-dedupe (job #1258)

taylor_sdk: thanks — also filing a follow-up issue to update the sampleapp onboarding guide so authors run `./scripts/generate-changelog.sh` locally before opening release PRs. :+1: 

mike_devex: if CI passes, let's fast-track the publish unblock. If it flakes again, we might add a pre-publish sanity check on the CI gate to catch duplicate entries.

raj_typegen: will push patch in ~30m. cc @sarah_engineering for review on the integration test scenarios.
